# ClinicOps

ClinicOps is a Danish-led, EU-wide evidence-controlled clinical and life-sciences operations company. Denmark is the local-market and localisation anchor; delivery is English-first and EU-wide, with Danish language, authority and professional expertise brought into scope when relevant.

Core pages:
- ClinicOps | EU MedTech Regulatory Data Integrity: https://clinicops.dk/ - Keep EUDAMED, UDI, certificates, SS(C)P and controlled records aligned when products change. Deterministic comparison, a reviewer-ready closure queue.
- About ClinicOps | EU MedTech Regulatory Data Integrity: https://clinicops.dk/about.html - A one-person EU MedTech regulatory data integrity practice: MSc in Medicine, pharmacovigilance and CRO background, 500+ regulated assignments, native Danish.
- Scope a ClinicOps Review | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/assessment-intake.html - Build a concise ClinicOps clinical-operations review scope brief in your browser, then open it in your email client. No form data is transmitted by this page.
- Contact ClinicOps | EU MedTech Regulatory Data Integrity: https://clinicops.dk/contact.html - Contact ClinicOps to scope a Regulatory Change Integrity Review, a portfolio integrity scan, Denmark market access or Danish pharmacovigilance support.
- Solution | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/services.html - The Regulatory Change Integrity Review: one approved change reconciled against EUDAMED, UDI, certificates, SS(C)P and controlled records, with closure evidence.
- Use Cases | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/use-cases.html - Where the discipline is applied: EUDAMED and UDI data, SS(C)P operations, class III MDR transition, AR portfolios, document control, language versions, Denmark.

Solution and use cases:
- EU Authorised Representative Portfolio Intelligence | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/authorised-representative-portfolio-intelligence.html - Evidence reconciliation and transition prioritisation for authorised representatives and consultancies managing many MedTech manufacturers.
- Class III and Implantable MDR Transition Intelligence | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/class-iii-transition.html - Legacy versus MDR paths, certificate and transition timing, and SS(C)P duty context for class III and implantable device portfolios.
- Denmark Market Access | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/denmark-market-access.html - Denmark market access for medical devices and IVDs: authority mapping, controlled Danish localisation, evidence reconciliation and Danish pharmacovigilance.
- EU MDR Regulatory Data Integrity for Global MedTech | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/eu-mdr-regulatory-integrity.html - Evidence-controlled EU MDR regulatory information review, remediation and change operations for medical-device manufacturers worldwide supporting the EU market.
- EUDAMED Transition Work Plans for MedTech | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/eudamed-transition.html - Turn legacy and MDR portfolio evidence into a prioritised EUDAMED transition work plan with role-aware screening, evidence gaps and human regulatory review.
- Regulatory Change Integrity Review | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/evidence-change-control-pack.html - One declared change and evidence population turned into a source register, change-surface matrix, unresolved queue and closure packet.
- Evidence pack checklist | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/evidence-pack-checklist.html - What to gather before a ClinicOps review: exports, records, version-control expectations and what not to send.
- Specialist Clinical Review | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/expert-network.html - Independent clinical subject-matter review, across medicine and nursing, where a regulatory, safety or product-information question needs clinical context.
- Regulatory Integrity Review for MedTech | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/integrity-gate.html - Human-reviewed regulatory information reconciliation and change-propagation review across EUDAMED, IFU, SS(C)P, labels and client-controlled systems.
- Medical Device Regulatory Document Control | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/medical-device-document-control.html - Reconciliation-as-evidence review of consistency across EUDAMED records, IFU, labelling and market-language versions for MedTech, with RA/QA retaining sign-off.
- EU Medical Device Regulatory Intelligence | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/regulatory-intelligence.html - EU medical device regulatory intelligence with the evidence intact: capture signals, keep actor context, separate screening from conclusions.
- SS(C)P Operations and Evidence Workflows | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/sscp-operations.html - Organise SS(C)P evidence, Basic UDI-DI relationships, translations and operational handoffs with a human-reviewed MedTech regulatory work plan.
- What a pilot looks like | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/what-a-pilot-looks-like.html - What a ClinicOps pilot covers, how it runs, what you receive, and who decides.

Free browser-local tools and examples:
- Change Surface Mapper | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/change-surface-mapper.html - Map one approved change across affected systems, records, documents and owners, in your browser. A portable evidence brief; nothing is uploaded.
- Danish DHPC Submission Checker | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/danish-dhpc-checker.html - Free checklist for a Danish DHPC to the Danish Medicines Agency's documented rules: submission pack, format, plain-Danish translation, evidence. Browser-local.
- Danish Local-Literature Source Register | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/danish-pv-literature-register.html - Source-verified register of Danish periodicals for GVP Module VI local-literature monitoring, with a justification memo and screening-log generator.
- EUDAMED Identifier Check | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/identifier-check.html - Free, browser-only EUDAMED Identifier Check: B-prefix legacy screening, SRN actor-role decoding, and GS1 Mod-10 validation. Nothing is sent to ClinicOps.
- Free Regulatory Change Integrity Check | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/integrity-check.html - Build a browser-local evidence packet for one regulatory change: provenance, downstream comparison, gaps, owner routing, JSON fingerprint. No upload.
- Regulatory Change Review Cost Calculator | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/integrity-economics.html - Estimate the manual workload and labour cost of checking that a regulatory change reached EUDAMED, IFU, SS(C)P, labels and controlled systems.
- Regulatory Integrity Scanner | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/integrity-scanner.html - Check one approved change against downstream records, or scan a portfolio export for missing fields, duplicates and conflicts. Browser-local, exportable.
- Transition Readiness Score | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/readiness-score.html - A private, browser-only screening aid for organising EUDAMED transition work-plan evidence before a human regulatory review.
- Regulatory Change Impact Mapper | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/regulatory-change-impact.html - Pick a category of EU regulatory change, answer six portfolio questions, and get an impacted-surface checklist with severity bands. Browser-local.
- SDEA / PV Agreement Clause Checker | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/sdea-clause-checker.html - Screen a PV agreement or SDEA against the clause set required from 12 February 2026 by Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/1466 and GVP. Browser-local.
- Interactive Regulatory Integrity Specimen Register | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/specimen-register/ - A synthetic integrity register: traceable reference evidence, observations, discrepancy states, review owners and explicit human decisions.
- Technical File Consistency Check | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/technical-file-consistency.html - Paste one key fact as it appears in up to five technical-documentation sources and get a severity-banded divergence report. Browser-local.
- Tools & Evidence | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/tools.html - Browser-local regulatory data integrity tools: the Regulatory Integrity Scanner, identifier check, change and consistency utilities, PV utilities and specimens.
- ClinicOps Class III Transition Map — Sanitized Sample: https://clinicops.dk/transition-map-sample/ - Sanitized fictional sample of the ClinicOps Class III Transition Map work-plan format.

- The published SS(C)P and the public EUDAMED record — what a reader can and cannot reconcile | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/research/sscp-public-record-scan/ - Public-source scan, September 2026: what a published SS(C)P and the public EUDAMED record can and cannot reconcile — identifiers, revisions, legacy DIs and pack records.

Policies:
- Privacy Notice | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/privacy-notice/ - How ClinicOps processes personal data: website, email enquiries, client engagements, and business-development outreach, including your right to object.

Operating boundaries:
- ClinicOps structures evidence, reconciliation and operational change; it does not turn machine findings into legal, regulatory, clinical, safety, quality or compliance determinations.
- Missing public records or links do not by themselves establish non-compliance.
- Source authority, professional judgement and release decisions remain explicit human responsibilities.
- Public-source coverage is bounded by the declared method and evidence population.
- Independent experts are engaged only within a defined project scope after credential, availability and conflict checks; their participation does not transfer reserved professional authority to ClinicOps.
